title: Seven price moves between buyer agent and listing agent, each a from/to change, ending in mutual acceptance at $960,000

task.goal: Buy 56 Wexley Lane for the Iyers: price no more than $975,000 and within the appraisal, closing by Wed Dec 30.

Helen,

notes: Our side goes $925,000 -> $945,000 -> $955,000 -> $960,000; the seller goes $989,000 -> $972,000 -> $965,000 -> $960,000, mostly said as "from X to Y". Each new statement replaces only that speaker's own previous price; the other side's price is untouched. Closing moves from Dec 21 to Dec 18 in the seller's third move. Every reply quotes the whole chain, so all old prices keep reappearing below the new text. Counter #1 becomes partially stale and is superseded by counter #2. Distractors: $995,000 list price, MLS #, HOA, taxes, $30,000 EMD.
